pr_title: Only damage popups when popups have damage
pr_body:
The previous behaviour was to damage the entire view, which would recurse into each popup. This patch makes it damage only the popup's surface, and respect the surface damage given by the client.

This adds listeners to the popup's map and unmap events rather than doing the damage in the create and destroy functions. To get the popup's position relative to the view, a new `child_impl` function `get_root_coords` has been introduced, which traverses up the parents.

Fixes #2601

issue_context.title: Damage issues with popups
issue_context.body:
To replicate: open 2 gnome-terminal windows side by side and open the right click menu such that it overlaps. Click on the window you opened the terminal on again to close it. The menu will remain partially visible on the other window until its damaged (e.g. by focus).
Also reproducible on transmission-gtk popups (the black ones when hovering over files or clients).
